note: A heading with its content and the space around them, from a pod's own layouts (decision element-roles-and-reuse)

component.doc: A section of a page: space above, a quiet heading (core:section_label), then its children (usually one core:grouped_list or a card). Put sections one after another in a core://Column with spacing 0; in a list's group header a section shows only while its group has rows.

params.name: space_above
params.doc: Space above the heading in dp.
